## AC4 is PROVED — positively, by name, on `windows-latest`

Sweep run `33964744328`, job `101302847243`, step "Prove the Windows exclusive leg (named
verdicts)":

```
test_windows_exclusive_leg.py::test_no_leg_acquire_refuses_loudly_and_never_takes_the_mkdir_leg PASSED
test_windows_exclusive_leg.py::test_no_leg_busy_probe_fails_open PASSED
test_windows_exclusive_leg.py::test_no_leg_doctor_probe_reports_unknown PASSED
test_windows_leg_write_lock_round_trips SKIPPED
test_windows_leg_excludes_a_second_acquirer SKIPPED
test_windows_leg_exclusion_survives_the_mkdir_leg_being_removed SKIPPED
test_windows_leg_busy_probe_answers_truthfully SKIPPED
test_windows_leg_doctor_probe_answers_truthfully SKIPPED
test_windows_exclusive_leg.py::test_pid_probe_never_signals_where_signal_zero_terminates PASSED
test_windows_exclusive_leg.py::test_narrowed_pid_probe_does_not_reclaim_a_fresh_lock_without_proof PASSED
test_windows_exclusive_leg.py::test_native_lock_is_visible_across_processes PASSED
test_windows_exclusive_leg.py::test_native_lock_dies_with_its_holder PASSED
======================== 7 passed, 5 skipped in 7.74s =========================
```

Both properties the whole design rests on are now established rather than inferred: the lock is
visible ACROSS PROCESSES, and the kernel releases it when the holder dies. `fcntl_held=True`
stands on Windows. AC4 ticked; all six ACs are now ticked.

**One intermediate failure worth recording, because it was invisible in a way this ticket is
about.** Patchset 1's proof step died in 3 SECONDS with
`ParserError: Missing '(' after 'if' in if statement` — `windows-latest`'s default shell is
`pwsh`, not bash, so the if-present guard was never shell the runner could parse and pytest never
started. Fixed with `shell: bash` (also the shell the guard's own parity test executes these
bodies under). The step is now `continue-on-error` as well, answering the review's advisory: a red
proof is still named AND marked failed, but no longer costs the sweep its own default-suite run.

**Residual `fcntl` noise in that same run is NOT this story's.** The default suite still logs 115
`AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'flock'` — every one of them from
`reducer/marker.py::write_marker` (`fcntl.flock(lock_fd, fcntl.LOCK_EX)`), which is bug
`nitro-heavy-bluefish` and is named as out-of-scope in this story's own description. The store
write-lock path itself (`lock.py` / `lock_owner.py` / `doctor_locks.py`) contributes zero, which
is what AC6 claims. The 1,516 `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'fcntl'` are likewise other
modules — `hyperbolic-humanoid-owl` (`_store/fsutil.py`) and the reconciler's sidecar
transactions.

## NOT CLOSING — change 2675 is `Verified -1`, and the -1 is not ours

`https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/2675` (patchset 3) has **`LLM-Review +1`**. Its
`Verified -1` comes from ONE job, `optionality … / terraform-config-inspect pinned canary`, failing
`assert 'abstain' == 'match'` — which is **already failing on `main`** (optionality run
`33967130573`, `headBranch main`) and is already tracked as bug `widish-chemic-goitered`
(`f95d-19f6-7e58-4a8e`, p1, in_progress), whose description is this exact assertion. No duplicate
filed, and no `recheck`: it is a real main defect, not an environmental fault.

AGENTS.md is explicit that a ticket does not close until its change is `Verified +1`, so this stays
`in_progress` pending that unrelated fix. Everything this story owns is done and evidenced.

Also worth flagging for whoever closes it: the description is now 8,779 characters, over the
8,000-char plan-review admission cap. It was already over before this edit, so it is pre-existing —
but a future re-claim would need it shortened.
